title: Why Body Temperature Is No Longer 98.6
hook: The temperature everyone memorized changed—and its original benchmark was shaky.
closing: Normal temperature reflects both changing bodies and a standard that was never exact.
question: What is your resting temperature?

segments.say: Modern men average 97.5 degrees, down from 98.6. Bodies now run cooler than the familiar standard.
Men cooled by 1.06 degrees, nearly twice the drop in women. The shift appears across generations.
The original 98.6-degree benchmark recalculates to 98.2. Changing bodies exposed an already imperfect standard.
